name: Eleanor Vance
bio: With over 15 years of experience in the publishing industry, Eleanor founded Design Dile with a passion for storytelling through art. Her work has graced the covers of numerous bestsellers.

name: Marcus Thorne
bio: Marcus is a master of illustration and visual narrative. He brings a unique artistic flair to every project, ensuring each design is not just seen, but felt.

name: Clara Bell
bio: Clara is a typography enthusiast who believes that a book's interior is just as important as its cover. She meticulously crafts layouts that are a joy to read.

name: Samuel Ortiz
bio: Sam is the organizational heart of the team. He ensures that every project runs smoothly, on time, and that our clients are happy from start to finish.
